title: 第261章 精怪第260章 烂摊子
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：西游：刚准备尸解成仙，猴子来找第一卷：默认第261章精怪（..la）问罢，把那笤帚往地上一顿，便要挽起袖子去后山拿妖。陶潜将那混元白玉拂尘在空中一拦，呵呵笑道：“你这呆子，休要多事，不必去理会它。”
杨明停下步子，疑惑道：“师父，既是外来的精怪落入咱们地界，怎的不拿来审个明白？”
陶潜端起石台上那碗冷茶，吃了一口，缓声道：“那不过是个草木化形的精怪，为师观它气象，清正平和，未曾沾染半点血食，是吸些日精月华罢了，不曾做甚么恶事，身上并无业力加身。
想来是这战国乱世之中，那些个走外丹术的炼气士四处搜罗天材地宝，寻到了它的根脚，要拿它去鼎炉里炼丹，故而下狠手将它打伤了。它既慌不择路，逃入咱们这鬼谷山中避难，也是个可怜见的东西。它既藏在山中，便由它藏着罢了，莫去惊动它。”
杨明听了这话，挠了挠头，又道：“师父，既然它是被人追杀，咱们这山头也是个清静所在，若是那打伤它的炼气士顺着云头寻上门来，要在咱们后山搜罗生事，咱们管还是不管？”
陶潜将茶碗搁下，目视远山，只道：“若是那精怪被逼得无路可走，自家找上门来，求到了你的跟前，你便顺手管上一管，打发了那些个炼气士也无妨。若是它不曾来求你，你便只作不知，切莫主动去插手。我等修行中人，行事当因缘而定。缘法到了，自然该管；缘法未到，你去强求有何用？”
杨明听罢，心下豁然开朗，打个问讯道：“师父说得是，弟子记下了。”
说罢，重又拾起那把笤帚，自顾自扫那满地的落叶松针去了。
陶潜把那混元白玉拂尘在臂弯里一搭，呵呵笑了一声，转过身去，木杖点着青石，不紧不慢地顺着山道去了。
单表这杨明，在后头打个问讯，目送师父走远，便转过身来，把那笤帚往手里紧了紧，自顾自干他的活计。
他顺着这后山的小径，一路扫将下去。这鬼谷山中虽说清静，到底常有弟子上下，只是这后山偏僻，久无人迹，落叶松针积了厚厚一层。
杨明运起丹田里的五行之气，手中笤帚挥舞得呼呼作响，不消半日工夫，便将那满地枯叶扫得干干净净，清出一条平整山路来。
扫到半山腰处，见两旁荆棘丛生，藤蔓交错，挡了去路。
杨明便把笤帚靠在树上，从腰间拔出一口柴刀来，左右挥砍。
他如今也是采了五行之药的修行人，臂力过人，那柴刀在他手里使得如飞一般，只听得喀嚓喀嚓几声响，便将那些个拦路的荆棘草木尽数斩断，清理得豁然开朗，倒方便了日后行人路过。
杨明一边开路，一边暗自留心周遭的动静。
他是个实诚人，听了陶潜那番言语，便当真不去管那跌落云头的精怪。只是他心中也暗暗称奇，那精怪着实是个谨慎的，方才跌下来时还带着一股子青碧交加的木气，这会子落入山中，竟如泥牛入海，半点气息也寻不着了。
杨明运起目力，往那深林密处扫了几眼，莫说是个精怪，便是一只飞鸟也未曾惊动，端的是藏得严实，让人看不到也找不着。
杨明收了柴刀，重又拿起笤帚，心道：“师父说得是，因缘而救？它既藏得这般好，便由它去罢了。”
当下再不理会，只管专心扫地开路，直扫到山脚下方才作罢。

做完这一切，杨明收了柴刀，提着笤帚，顺着清出来的山道往回走。
行不数里，正过一片茂林，忽听得路旁草丛中“窸窸窣窣”一阵乱响。
杨明把笤帚往地上一顿，暗自防备，只道是甚么山猫野兽。定睛看时，却见那齐腰深的蒿草里，钻出一个五六岁的女娃娃来。
这女娃儿生得十分乖巧可爱，只是此刻显得极是狼狈。
头上乱糟糟的，挂满了枯黄落叶与苍耳；身上穿着一件破旧的青布小袄，沾满了泥污，小脸蛋上也东一道西一道的尽是灰土，活脱脱一个刚从泥潭里爬出来的小叫花子。
杨明见状，心头大奇，暗想：“这鬼谷山深处，平素连个樵夫也少见，哪里来的这等小娃儿？”
当即走上前去，俯下身子问道：“小娃儿，你是谁家的？怎的孤身一个待在这荒山野岭之中？这山里头常有虎狼出没，你这般乱跑，也不怕被那野狼叼了去塞牙缝？”
那女娃娃本就怯生生的，听得杨明这般问，小嘴一瘪，眼眶里顿时滚出两包泪来，吧嗒吧嗒往下掉，抽噎着答道：
“我……我走丢了。我阿爹把我带到这山里，说要去寻些吃食，便再没回来。他……他定是把我丢在这山中，不要我了！”
说罢，便一屁股坐在地上，抹着眼泪哇哇大哭起来，哭得好不伤心。
杨明见她哭得可怜，不由得动了恻隐之心。
忽然心头一动，想起方才师父陶潜所言，那半空里跌落下来的草木精怪。暗自思量：“师父说那精怪清正平和，是个草木之属。莫非这小女娃，便是那受了伤的精怪化形的？只是瞧她这般模样，全无半点妖气，倒像个寻常人家的苦命孩儿罢了。”
杨明把眼一抹，将这女娃娃上下打量了一番，心中暗自犯嘀咕：“这荒山野岭，平素连个人也少见，怎的偏偏半空里掉下个精怪，这草窠里就冒出个走失的女娃？天下哪有这等巧事！莫不正是那草木精怪变作这般模样来撮弄人？”
只是他转念一想，这女娃娃说走丢不是没有可能的，有些穷苦人养不起了，就会选择将众多孩子中最没有用的丢弃，在宗法观念中没有男丁便代表传承断绝，没有女子，只是少了一个赔钱货。
不只是穷苦人，实际上上一些贵族也是这么做的，产男相贺，产女相杀，男丁可以留下香火，女子不能养老，出嫁时还要出嫁妆，出嫁以后，家中还少了一个人的劳动力，故而弃婴极多，但多为女婴，因为这笔买卖并不划算。..la

Recommended reading for all book friends: Journey to the West: Just about to turn the corpse into an immortal, the monkey comes to find the first volume: Default Chapter 261 The spirit (..la) After asking, he threw the broom on the ground, then rolled up his sleeves and went to the back mountain to get the monster. Tao Qian stopped the Hunyuan White Jade Whisk in the air and said with a smile: "You idiot, don't worry about it. Don't pay attention to it."
Yang Ming stopped and asked doubtfully: "Master, since an alien spirit has fallen into our territory, why don't we bring it in for questioning?"
Tao Qian picked up the bowl of cold tea on the stone platform, took a sip, and said slowly: "That's just a spirit that took the form of vegetation. I observed its appearance as a teacher. It is pure and peaceful. It has not been contaminated by any blood. It just sucked some essence of the sun and the moon. It has not done any evil deeds and has no karma attached to it."
It seems that during the chaotic times of the Warring States Period, those alchemists who practiced external alchemy searched everywhere for heavenly materials and earthly treasures, found its roots, and wanted to use it to refine elixirs in the cauldron, so they wounded it ruthlessly. It panicked and took refuge in our ghost valley mountains. It was also a pitiful thing. Since it is hidden in the mountains, just let it be hidden and don't disturb it. "
After hearing this, Yang Ming scratched his head and said, "Master, since it is being hunted, our mountaintop is also a quiet place. If the Qi Master who injured it follows the clouds to find us and wants to cause trouble in our back mountain, should we care or not?"
Tao Qian put down the tea bowl, looked at the distant mountains, and said: "If the spirit is forced to have no way out, and comes to seek help from you, you can take care of it and send away those Qi refiners." No matter. If it has not come to you, just pretend that you don't know and don't take the initiative to intervene. When the fate comes, it will be taken care of. What's the use of forcing it?"
After hearing this, Yang Ming felt enlightened and asked: "Master is right, I have written it down."
After that, he picked up the broom again and went to sweep the larch needles all over the floor.
Tao Qian put the Hunyuan white jade whisk in his arm, chuckled, turned around, lit the bluestone with his wooden stick, and walked leisurely along the mountain path.
Yang Ming, who was alone, called for inquiries from behind, watched the master go away, then turned around, held the broom tightly in his hand, and went about his work.
He followed the path in the back mountain and swept all the way down. Although the Guigu Mountain is said to be quiet, there are always disciples coming and going. However, the back mountain is remote and has not been visited for a long time, and there is a thick layer of larch needles.
Yang Ming mobilized the energy of the five elements in his Dantian, waving the broom in his hand with a whirring sound. In less than half a day, he swept away the dead leaves on the ground and cleared a smooth mountain road.
When I swept halfway up the mountain, I saw thorns on both sides and intertwined vines blocking the way.
Yang Ming leaned his broom against the tree, pulled out a hatchet from his waist, and slashed left and right.
Now he is also a cultivator who has collected the medicine of the five elements. He has extraordinary arm strength. The hatchet flies in his hand. With only a few clicks, he cuts off all the thorns and vegetation blocking the road. The clearing is clear, which makes it easier for pedestrians to pass by in the future.
Yang Ming opened the way while secretly paying attention to the movements around him.
He was an honest man, and after hearing Tao Qian's words, he really didn't care about the falling spirit. But he also secretly marveled at the fact that the spirit was really cautious. When it fell down, it still had a woody aura mixed with green and green. Now it fell into the mountain, like a mud cow entering the sea, and could not find any breath at all.
Yang Ming raised his eyes and took a few glances at the deep forest. Not only was it a monster, not even a bird was disturbed. It was hidden so tightly that no one could see or find it.
Yang Ming put away the hatchet and picked up the broom again, thinking: "Master is right, fate will save you? Since it is hidden so well, let it go."
Ignore it now, justGuan concentrated on sweeping the ground to clear the way, and did not stop until he reached the foot of the mountain.
After doing all this, Yang Ming put away the hatchet, carried the broom, and walked back along the cleared mountain path.
After walking a few miles, we were passing through a lush forest when we suddenly heard a "rustling" sound in the grass beside the road.
Yang Ming slammed the broom on the ground and secretly defended himself, thinking it was some kind of lynx beast. When he looked closely, he saw a five or six-year-old girl emerging from the waist-deep wormwood.
This baby girl was born very cute and well-behaved, but she looked extremely embarrassed at the moment.
His head was a mess, covered with withered yellow leaves and cockleburs; he was wearing a shabby green cloth jacket, stained with mud, and his little face was covered with dust here and there, making him look like a little beggar who had just crawled out of the mire.
When Yang Ming saw this, he was very surprised and thought to himself: "In the depths of Guigu Mountain, it is rare to see a woodcutter. Where did such a little kid come from?"
He immediately walked forward, leaned down and asked, "Little kid, whose family do you belong to? Why are you staying alone in this barren mountain? There are often tigers and wolves in this mountain. You are running around like this, and you are not afraid of being picked up by the wild wolf and stuffed between your teeth?"
The girl was timid, but when she heard Yang Ming ask this question, her little mouth shrank, and two bags of tears suddenly rolled out of her eyes, and they fell down. She sobbed and replied:
"I...I'm lost. My father took me to this mountain and said he was going to find some food, but he never came back. He...he must have left me in this mountain and didn't want me anymore!"
After that, he sat down on the ground, wiped his tears and cried loudly. He cried so sadly.
Yang Ming saw her crying pitifully and couldn't help but feel sympathy.
Suddenly, my mind moved, and I remembered what Master Tao Qian had said just now, about the strange vegetation that fell in mid-air. He thought to himself: "Master said that the spirit is pure and peaceful, and is a species of grass and trees. Could it be that this little girl is the injured spirit incarnation? It's just that she looks like this, there is no trace of evil at all, she looks more like a poor child of an ordinary family."
Yang Ming wiped his eyes and looked the girl up and down, and murmured to himself: "In these barren mountains and ridges, people are rarely seen. How come a spirit fell from the air, and a lost girl appeared in this grass nest? How can there be such a coincidence in the world! Could it be that the grass and trees monsters changed their appearance like this to tease people?"
But then he thought about it, it was not impossible that the female doll got lost. Some poor people would choose to throw away the most useless of the many children when they couldn't afford it. In the patriarchal concept, the absence of boys means the inheritance is cut off, and the absence of girls means that there is only one less loser.
Not only the poor, but actually some nobles also did this. They congratulated each other after giving birth to boys and killed each other after giving birth to girls. The boys could leave incense, but the girls could not support them in old age. They had to pay a dowry when they got married. After getting married, there was one less labor force in the family, so there were a lot of abandoned babies, but most of them were girls, because the deal was not cost-effective. ..la
